name: INI / ENV Parser
summary: Parse and convert .env, INI, and JSON config formats in your browser.
description: Paste dotenv, INI, or JSON and convert between formats. Useful for migrating secrets, config files, and local development setup — all locally.

faqs.question: Are comments preserved?
faqs.answer: Comments are ignored during parsing. Converting back to .env or INI will not restore original comments.

faqs.question: Nested JSON to INI?
faqs.answer: Top-level object keys become INI sections; flat keys go under a default section.
